spaces.name: West entrance court (sunken; covered at north)

assumptions.statement: EXPLORATORY. Topology of the shared lift and family stair and the floor plates are agent design decisions from the section study and owner answers of 2026-10-22; room geometry is CP-SAT exact tiling per floor. Levels: road 1677.7 (near road-edge spots 1677.44-1677.81), upper 1674.3, lower 1670.7, lawn 1668.3. North wall on the boundary (owner: no north limit). West court excavated to the upper level (owner idea). Room sizes are agent proposals, not an approved program. Structure, retaining walls, drainage, waterproofing and codes are unresolved.
